text:
alex: Observed a repeatable oscillation during yesterday's tenant surge. prefixes kept bouncing between nodes, causing double-evict/double-prefetch loops. metrics `prefix_eviction_rate` + `prefix_rebind_count` jumped.

maria: can you paste a compact log snippet and shard id? :eyes:

alex: shard-47, tenant=frost-data. snippet:
```
2026-03-17T22:11:02Z evict prefix=data/77 by policy=soft
2026-03-17T22:11:02Z rebind prefix=data/77 -> node-12
2026-03-17T22:11:03Z evict prefix=data/77 by policy=soft
2026-03-17T22:11:03Z rebind prefix=data/77 -> node-47
```
p95 latency jumped from ~10ms -> ~240ms during the volley.

sam: sounds like two nodes both detect hotness and steal; repeated handoffs.

jon: naive fix is a global sequencer to linearize handoffs but that's invasive.

alex: proposal: cooldown + epoch-trim heuristic. High level:
- on demote/evict, stamp prefix with cooldown_ts (configurable)
- receivers defer aggressive prefill while cooldown active unless they present a valid lease_proof
- maintain lease_epoch; bump only after eviction ack clears

pseudo:
```
if now < prefix.cooldown_ts && !is_hot(prefix):
  delay_prefetch(backoff_ms)
else:
  accept_rebind()
```
params: cooldown_ms=2000 default, max_backoff_ms=15000.

maria: tradeoffs?

alex: pros: local change, low risk, avoids global sequencer. cons: can increase first-read latency on legit moves, may hide actual capacity issues if set too long.

sam: how do we define is_hot(prefix)? we can use `qps_rolling` + `recent_kv_hits`. gateway could bypass cooldown if qps > threshold.

jon: concern: dishonest node could claim hotness. need lease_proof tie to source.

alex: design: cooldown bypass allowed if receiver provides lease_proof (lease_id, epoch, source_sig) OR a lease_catalog entry (short-lived central object).

maria: issuing signed tokens from nodes adds key management. lease_catalog TTL lookup is simpler.

sam: agreed. v1: use small shared lease_catalog (fast lookup) as proof. No new crypto.

alex: impl plan v1:
- add prefix.cooldown_ts persisted locally
- receivers check lease_catalog before bypassing cooldown
- add metrics `prefix_cooldown_blocked_prefetch`, `prefix_cooldown_bypassed`
- opt-in flag for rollout

jon: alerts: add detector when rebind_count / evict_count > 0.5 for same prefix over 1m. Also track bounce_count per-prefix.

maria: tests: integration smoke to simulate two nodes racing; assert <3 rebinds in 10s. I'll own the harness.

alex: rollout: instrument + opt-in -> canary pool with cooldown_ms=500 -> iterate to 2s default. watch prefill misses and client latency.

sam: edge cases: clock skew -> prefer monotonic epochs where possible; adaptive cooldown for prefixes with repeated bounces.

alex: alternative we evaluated: source-based admission (source delays evict while receiver prefetches) but that needs cross-node coordination and risks memory overcommit. rejected for now.

jon: v2 thought: lightweight per-shard sequencer to order handoffs (cheaper than global). keep on roadmap.

eviction-bot: NOTE: added `prefix_rebind_spike_detector` alert (experimental) with 5m lookback.

alex: next actions: alex writes small RFC + pseudocode + metrics. maria adds unit/integration tests. sam drafts lease_catalog API. Target canary next week.

maria: will add smoke tests and local harness. Also add metrics dashboard to monitor cooldown hits.

sam: i'll sketch lease_catalog endpoints (mint, lookup, revoke) and perf budget.

jon: ack. i'll add to eng-runtime roadmap and track sequencer follow-up if cooldown insufficient.

alex: note: keep default cooldown conservative to avoid surprising tail latency increases for rare prefixes.

maria: thanks all. closing thread after RFC PR is up. :thumbsup:
